protocol:
1. Keep labeled microcentrifuge/PCR tubes in a green ice bucket and arrange tube racks, pipette tips, and an adjustable micropipette at the bench.

2. Using an adjustable micropipette with disposable tips, dispense liquid from tubes in the blue rack into each labeled tube held on ice; the reagent identity and pipette volume are not visible.

3. Cap the filled tubes and keep them on ice after dispensing.

4. Briefly centrifuge the capped tubes in a benchtop mini-centrifuge with a blue/yellow rotor to collect liquid at the bottom of the tubes; speed and duration are not visible.

5. Load the prepared tubes or plate into a Bio-Rad T100 thermal cycler block.

6. Close the Bio-Rad T100 thermal cycler lid and start the displayed thermocycler program, using the on-screen reaction volume setting of 25 µL.

7. Confirm the run on the touchscreen and begin thermocycling.
